description: Append URLs to a batch job that was submitted with `open: true`. Same item vocabulary as `spicrawl_batch_submit` (EITHER `urls` or `items`, not both, plus shared settings for these new items). Fails with CONFLICT if the job is closed or finished. Not idempotent: calling twice adds the URLs twice. Returns `{ job, items_added, items_dispatched }`.

block_resources.description: Resource types to block while rendering, e.g. ["image","font","media"].

custom_headers.description: Extra request headers sent with every URL.

format.description: Output format for every item (`response_format`). spicrawl_batch_submit defaults to 'markdown', the same as spicrawl_scrape; an item's own `response_format` overrides it.

items.description: Long form: one /v1/scrape request object per item. Besides `url` and `external_id`, any /v1/scrape field (e.g. `js_render`, `wait_for`, `response_format`) overrides the shared setting for that item only. Mutually exclusive with `urls`.

external_id.description: Your own correlation id, echoed back on this item's result record.

job_id.description: The batch job id returned by spicrawl_batch_submit or spicrawl_batch_list.

main_content_only.description: Strip each page to its main article.

max_cost.description: Ceiling in credits for ONE item (not the whole job — see credit_budget).

render.description: Render every URL with a browser (`js_render`).

urls.description: Shorthand: URLs scraped with the shared settings and no per-item overrides. Mutually exclusive with `items`.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after load (rendered scrapes).

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before capturing (rendered scrapes).

name: spicrawl_batch_add_items

items_dispatched.description: Of those, how many reached the dispatch queue now; do not re-add the rest.

job.description: The job as it stands after the call.

cancel_requested_at.description: ISO-8601 time a cancel was accepted.

concurrency.description: Effective per-job concurrency after the server's clamping.

error_code.description: Machine code of a job-level failure.

estimated_credits.description: Credits reserved at submission (a hold, not a charge; compare with progress.credits_charged).

failure_threshold.description: Failed-item count that aborts the job, when set.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 time the job reached a terminal status.

id.description: Job id. Pass it as `job_id` to the other spicrawl_batch_* tools.

name.description: The label given at submission, if any.

open.description: True while the job accepts appended items (it will not complete until closed).

params.description: The job-level scrape settings as stored.

progress.description: Live item counters and the credits charged so far.

bytes.description: Total response bytes of finished items.

cancelled.description: Items not run because the job was cancelled.

completed.description: Items in any terminal status (succeeded + failed + cancelled + skipped).

credits_charged.description: Credits actually charged so far (whole credits, rounded down).

credits_charged_micro.description: Same as credits_charged in micro-credits (1 credit = 1,000,000).

failed.description: Items that failed after all attempts; re-run them with spicrawl_batch_retry.

skipped.description: Items skipped (for example after failure_threshold or credit_budget stopped the run).

succeeded.description: Items that succeeded. Only these are charged.

total.description: Items in the job (grows when items are appended to an open job).

project_id.description: Project the API key belongs to.

results_expire_at.description: ISO-8601 deadline after which results answer 410 Gone.

results_url.description: API path of the job's results: /v1/batch/{id}/results.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 time the first item started.

status.description: Lifecycle: queued, running, paused, cancelling, completed, failed or cancelled. Keep polling while queued/running/paused/cancelling; stop at completed, failed or cancelled.

status_url.description: API path to poll for this job: /v1/batch/{id}.

submitted_at.description: ISO-8601 time the job was accepted.

total_items.description: Number of items in the job.

warnings.description: Decisions made on the caller's behalf at submission (a clamped concurrency, items not yet queued).

title: Add URLs to an open batch job
